rationale: Charlie and Evan are both building Expo's vision of universal app development, but from complementary angles—Charlie drives the strategic conviction that Expo becomes the default platform for mobile and web apps, while Evan is implementing that vision through AI tooling with Expo Agent and React Server Components. Their shared conviction about React Native and cross-platform code sharing, combined with Evan's technical leadership in AI-driven developer tools and Charlie's founder/mentor experience, creates a natural pairing to align on Expo's AI-first product direction.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Evan Bacon — you're both building Expo's future but Evan's leading the AI tooling layer (Expo Agent, RSC) that makes your vision of Expo as the default platform actually achievable at scale.
